note: A second declared structure over the existing tree. It moves, renames, merges and deletes nothing.

nodes.authors: the routing layer's own constitution, vocabulary centre, and map of the six-layer body
boundary: does not author branch-local truth
does not promote a branch claim merely by being able to see or integrate it
does not become the territory it maps

compression.justification: Root is already minimal. Compressing the constitution into the README would make the fences reachable only through a surface that also carries promotional prose, which is how fences get quietly dropped.

residuals.statement: The sixth-order return is declared by enumeration in aggregates_residuals, not derived. The root lists the descendant residuals it carries; nothing yet generates that list from the descendants themselves.
residuals.reopening_condition: The auditor derives aggregates_residuals from the node set and this field becomes generated output rather than authored input.

residuals.statement: The graph is a flat star: nine nodes, all depth one, eight leaves. An adversarial review noted that despite the name, no node actually expands as a root -- there is no second level for a leaf residual to climb through. The recursion is asserted by the spec and not yet instantiated by the declaration.
residuals.reopening_condition: Declare a node with its own children on a branch that has real depth (split/minerva has kernel/development, kernel/runtime, kernel/state beneath kernel), and show a leaf residual propagating through an intermediate node to root.

nodes.authors: reader-facing routing surfaces: layer identity, now-map, cross-register handoff, closure pointer, visual and UI meta-theory
boundary: does not author the branch state it describes
a description of a branch claim is not an admission of it
NOW_MAP currency is asserted here but earned on the branches

compression.justification: Duplicate pointers across reader surfaces are gauge under F(docs): removing a repeated link does not change whether a fresh reader can reach live state. The one-paragraph state summaries are NOT gauge and may not be compressed; deleting one is what made the 2026-09-26 START_HERE rewrite inadmissible.

residuals.statement: CAUSAL_CHAIN_TRACE.md and RECURSIVE_NODE_ARCHITECTURE.md are assistant-derived candidates sitting beside admitted routing docs, distinguished only by a header line.
residuals.reopening_condition: Either admit them through the gate chain, or move candidates to a declared candidate subtree so register is structural rather than typographic.

residuals.statement: NOW_MAP.md asserts current branch heads. Nothing verifies that assertion against the actual refs.
residuals.reopening_condition: A check comparing NOW_MAP's claimed heads against git ls-remote, or an explicit statement that it is a snapshot with a date.

nodes.provenance: Reader surfaces for the routing layer.

nodes.authors: branch memory, namespace policy, layer pointers, epistemic anti-meme, pre-recrystallization record
boundary: historical evidence is immutable and is not current authority
presence in provenance does not mint live status
a recorded claim is not a verified claim

compression.justification: F(provenance) requires that the exact prior state be reconstructible and that deliberate retirement be distinguishable from incidental loss. Almost nothing here is gauge under that family.

residuals.statement: Canonical.zip pins three contaminated git blobs as verified live state. The routing layer has no record of this.
residuals.reopening_condition: Repin the package against the repaired head, or record here that it is non-authoritative for VM_INTERNALIZATION_PHASE_PLAN.json, DEVELOPMENTAL_GATE_CHAIN.json and SELF_TEACHING_DEVELOPMENT_DAG.json.

residuals.statement: The externalized payload root /Backup/CanonicalExternalPayloads/2026-09-26/ is unreachable from this machine, so byte-level custody is asserted rather than verified.
residuals.reopening_condition: Mount or relocate the payload root and verify the manifest hashes.

nodes.provenance: Historical custody for the routing layer.

boundary: defines how external parties may review; does not grant them authority to promote
does not author the claims under review

residuals.statement: The protocol describes external review, but no external reviewer is currently independent of the author. This is the V-not-independent-of-A weakness at the routing layer.
residuals.reopening_condition: A completed review by a party with no authorship relation to the branch under review.

boundary: a public control surface is not a sovereign controller
what is rendered publicly is not thereby admitted
does not author any claim it displays

compression.justification: Presentation markup is gauge under F(docs) so long as every distinction reachable in docs remains reachable on the site.

residuals.statement: The site renders routing claims but has no check that what it displays matches the docs it derives from.
residuals.reopening_condition: A check that every live pointer on the site resolves to a surface that still makes that claim.

nodes.provenance: Public projection of the routing layer.

nodes.authors: CI workflows, issue templates, funding metadata
boundary: CI pass is not independent returned evidence
a workflow may gate a merge but may not promote a claim
automation acts within jurisdiction; it does not extend it

compression.justification: Workflow steps are individually consequential; collapsing them is what replaced make audit with bisection globs on split/minerva.

residuals.statement: No workflow on this branch runs the node-graph auditor, so the declared structure is unenforced.
residuals.reopening_condition: Wire scripts/audit_node_graph.py into a workflow, once the branch author has admitted the graph.

boundary: licensing is not epistemic authority
does not author any claim about the work it licenses

compression.justification: License texts are reproduced verbatim by obligation.

nodes.residuals_absence_justification: Terminal legal surface with no open distinctions. Per RNA_R3 this absence is justified rather than defaulted.

boundary: an auditor checks structure, not correctness
a passing audit is not evidence a change is right
does not author the declarations it validates

residuals.statement: The node-graph auditor and the node graph it validates were introduced together by the same author in one episode. That is bootstrap rather than self-sealing, but it means neither has yet been checked by a party that did not write it.
residuals.reopening_condition: An independent review of the auditor against the graph, or a second graph authored by someone else that the auditor is run against.

nodes.provenance: Introduced 2026-09-26 with the node architecture candidate.

nodes.authors: negative suites demonstrating that the routing-layer auditors can fail
boundary: a passing test is not independent returned evidence
tests demonstrate the checker is non-vacuous; they do not validate the declaration it checks
does not author the structure under test

compression.justification: Each negative case pins a distinct rule. Collapsing them would leave a rule unexercised, which is how an auditor becomes vacuous without anyone noticing.

residuals.statement: N5 REACHABLE is the only rule with no isolated negative test. It currently cannot be violated without also violating N4, so it is untested rather than unfalsifiable.
residuals.reopening_condition: Construct a graph where a residual sits on a node unreachable from root while the parent links still form a valid tree, or prove that state is unconstructible and record N5 as implied by N4.

residuals.statement: No test runner is wired on this branch, so these tests run only when invoked by hand.
residuals.reopening_condition: A workflow step running python3 -m unittest discover tests, once the branch author admits the graph.
